Name: Shapely Shiko X Busty Zuzu City Girl
Author: bezajel
Description:
[center][size=6][img]https://i.postimg.cc/V6vhzY1B/slip.gif[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3r4KBhpk/back.gif[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=6]Shapely Sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url][/size][/center]
[center][spoiler][img]https://i.postimg.cc/VNny3sfr/topless.gif[/img][/spoiler]
[/center]

[size=5]General Options[/size]
[list]
[*]Choice of colour scheme: 
Original uses low-chroma black; Stardew uses saturated chromatic blacks; Purple uses chromatic blacks and gives her purple hair.[/*]
[*]'No Nose' option provided to match Seasonal Cute style[/*]
[*]Choice of Portrait style: original Busty Zuzu City Girl portraits, or FluffyCakeChan's alts[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Outfit Options[/size]
[list]
[*]Two regular outfits that can be randomised daily (plus nude option)[/*]
[*]Skimpier bikini, plus topless or nude beach options[/*]
[*]Option to wear beach outfit in Pelican town and the Desert (if she goes there?)[/*]
[*]Special outfit for in the farmhouse or her room at the saloon (opaque/transparent slip, or nude)[/*]
[*]Configurable choker accessory and sunglasses[/*]
[*]Optional sleep sprite - adds a sleeping animation to her schedule so she doesn't lie awake all night[/*]
[/list]

[size=5]Installation instructions[/size]
Unzip and place in your Mods folder.
Requires Content Patcher and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url] v1.6 or later.

Options can be configured in GMCM.
[b][size=4]Please disable the Seasonal outfits in the original Shiko Revived mod.[/size]
[/b]


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
While this mod is technically compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47872]vanilla (safe for work) version[/url], there are currently no matching portraits for the seasonal outfits.


[size=5]Future Development
[/size]In no particular order:
[list]
[*]Create recoloured versions of the included portraits to match Stardew colouring and purple hair sprite options[/*]
[*]Create seasonal versions of the Busty Zuzu City Girl portraits[/*]
[*]Adapt vanilla-style portraits to the outfits in this mod[/*]
[*]i18n for the extensive config?[/*]
[*]Hopefully not [i]too much[/i] bug fixing...[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Shout outs[/size]
Thanks to Papaya for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732]the OG Shiko mod[/url] for making a great character with timeless style.
Thanks to silvermoonchan for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]reviving Shiko[/url], giving me permission to create these sprites, and allowing me to tinker with the original mod.
Thanks to wetfart for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5374]Busty Zuzu City Girl[/url] mod. While the original sprites were not to my taste, I loved the portraits and concept.
Thanks to FluffyCakeChan for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7481]alternative portraits[/url] for Busty Zuzu City Girl.
Both Busty Zuzu City Girl mods provide open permissions, which was extremely helpful in making this mod function as smoothly as it does.
